characteristic_features: widely disseminated at diagnosis (stage III-IV common)

biomarkers.name: t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH-BCL2
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature in most grade 1-2 FL. Also detectable in healthy people at low levels — clinical context essential

biomarkers.name: CD20
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rituximab or obinutuzumab target. Obinutuzumab-based chemoimmunotherapy improved progression-free survival versus rituximab-based therapy in GALLIUM; overall survival benefit not demonstrated. Loss at relapse possible

biomarkers.name: CD19
biomarkers.clinical_use: CAR-T target in R/R FL after ≥2 lines (axi-cel — ZUMA-5; tisa-cel and liso-cel have also shown activity/approvals in R/R FL in some jurisdictions).

biomarkers.name: EZH2 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Tazemetostat (EZH2 inhibitor) approved for R/R EZH2-mutant FL and for R/R FL with no satisfactory alternative options; response rates are higher in EZH2-mutant disease

biomarkers.name: FLIPI / FLIPI2 / PRIMA-PI
biomarkers.clinical_use: FLIPI: age >60, stage III-IV, Hb <120 g/L, LDH >ULN, >4 nodal areas. FLIPI2 uses age >60, Hb <120 g/L, β2-microglobulin >ULN, bone marrow involvement, and largest node >6 cm. PRIMA-PI uses β2-microglobulin and bone marrow involvement. Prognostic risk stratification rather than direct treatment-intensity selection

biomarkers.name: POD24 (progression of disease within 24 months of therapy)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very adverse — associated with markedly inferior overall survival; triggers consideration of aggressive salvage strategies including cellular therapy in appropriate patients

biomarkers.name: Bispecific antibodies (CD20 × CD3): mosunetuzumab, epcoritamab
biomarkers.clinical_use: Mosunetuzumab (GO29781) approved for R/R FL after ≥2 prior lines. Epcoritamab has shown activity in FL and may be available in some settings/ongoing studies

biomarkers.name: Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) / minimal residual disease
biomarkers.clinical_use: MRD/ctDNA tracking is emerging in FL trials and is not standard routine care

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Neoplastic follicles composed of centrocytes (small cleaved) and centroblasts (large non-cleaved) with attenuated mantle zones; back-to-back nodules effacing nodal architecture
variants: paediatric-type FL (localised, indolent, without BCL2 rearrangement)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Grade 1-2 (indolent, treated similarly); grade 3A often managed similarly to indolent FL in many contexts; grade 3B treated as DLBCL/aggressive B-cell lymphoma

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Distinctive T cell / follicular dendritic cell microenvironment supports tumour cell survival — TME composition (including TFH cells and exhausted/checkpoint-expressing T-cell subsets such as LAG3+ cells) has prognostic associations; bispecific antibodies (mosunetuzumab CD20×CD3) exploit T cell engagement
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Nodular architecture with follicular dendritic cell meshwork (CD21+, CD23+); attenuated mantle zones

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Germinal centre B cells (centrocytes and centroblasts), usually with t(14;18)/BCL2 rearrangement
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains germinal centre B-cell differentiation with characteristic follicular architecture; expresses germinal centre markers (BCL6+, CD10+, HGAL+) with BCL2 overexpression in most conventional cases (often from t(14;18)); CD5-, CD23 variable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Recapitulates germinal centre B-cell biology — t(14;18) drives BCL2 overexpression preventing apoptosis normally required for germinal centre selection; recurrent mutations including CREBBP, KMT2D, EZH2, TNFRSF14 and EP300 help maintain the germinal centre program; transformation to DLBCL (~2-3%/year) represents progression through additional genetic events such as TP53, MYC and CDKN2A alterations
